prompt: A locked, washed-out wide view from a high corner of the cheap gym, looking down at Brandon sitting on the rubber floor beside a bench, clutching one arm against his chest, brows raised and bunched, eyelids pinched, mouth open, eyes aimed at the floor. Three gym-goers stand around the edges of the frame, turning their heads towards him: a man in a vest with a towel, a woman on a rowing machine, a teenager in a hoodie. The bar rests on its rack above the bench, level and still. The fluorescent tubes are flat and greenish, the mirror is cracked, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
